## #Final Model

```{r}

library(gbm)
library(bestglm)
library(tidyverse)
library(leaps)
library(glmnet)


kaggle_train <- read.csv("aluminum_coldRoll_train.csv")
kaggle_test <- read.csv("aluminum_coldRoll_testNoY.csv")

kaggle_train$alloy <- as.factor(kaggle_train$alloy)
kaggle_train$cutTemp <- as.factor(kaggle_train$cutTemp)
kaggle_train$topEdgeMicroChipping <- as.factor(kaggle_train$topEdgeMicroChipping)
kaggle_train$rollTemp <- as.factor(kaggle_train$rollTemp)
kaggle_train$blockSource <- as.factor(kaggle_train$blockSource)
kaggle_train$machineRestart <- as.factor(kaggle_train$machineRestart)
kaggle_train$firstPassRollPressure <- as.factor(kaggle_train$firstPassRollPressure)
kaggle_train$secondPassRollPressure <- as.factor(kaggle_train$secondPassRollPressure)
kaggle_train$contourDefNdx <- as.factor(kaggle_train$contourDefNdx)

kaggle_test$alloy <- as.factor(kaggle_test$alloy)
kaggle_test$cutTemp <- as.factor(kaggle_test$cutTemp)
kaggle_test$topEdgeMicroChipping <- as.factor(kaggle_test$topEdgeMicroChipping)
kaggle_test$rollTemp <- as.factor(kaggle_test$rollTemp)
kaggle_test$blockSource <- as.factor(kaggle_test$blockSource)
kaggle_test$machineRestart <- as.factor(kaggle_test$machineRestart)
kaggle_test$firstPassRollPressure <- as.factor(kaggle_test$firstPassRollPressure)
kaggle_test$secondPassRollPressure <- as.factor(kaggle_test$secondPassRollPressure)
kaggle_test$contourDefNdx <- as.factor(kaggle_test$contourDefNdx)

set.seed(111)

boost_model <- gbm(y_passXtremeDurability ~ alloy + cutTemp + rollTemp + firstPassRollPressure + secondPassRollPressure + topEdgeMicroChipping + blockSource + machineRestart + contourDefNdx + clearPassNdx, data = kaggle_amended, distribution = "bernoulli", n.trees = 9600, interaction.depth = 3, shrinkage = 0.01)

test_probabilities <- predict(boost_model, newdata = kaggle_test, n.trees = 9600, type = "response")

submission <- data.frame(ID = kaggle_test$ID, y_passXtremeDurability = test_probabilities)

write.csv(submission, "Stats101CKaggleV9.csv", row.names = FALSE)




```
